title: HOLD-LC-001 official gdt-fermi GbmRsp2 parser owner boundary
question: What exact mission-level parser semantics connect the pinned Fermi GBM GbmRsp2 product to the R-469 core Rsp2 implementation before any response validity, timing law or likelihood is admitted?
method: Preserve the established T-054 forward, T-059/T-061 observation-first, owner-order and promotion-firewall methods; add only a source-semantic crosswalk.
Hash-pin the official USRA-STI/gdt-fermi main commit and response.py source in a gitignored cache.
Use independent AST and token inspections of the GbmRsp2 classmethod open body; do not import the package, open a FITS product or read a matrix coefficient.
Verify delegation to core Rsp2, DRM_NUM iteration, per-segment header reconstruction, compressed-field access, decompression, response-object construction and aggregate assembly.
Run primary, independent, hostile, integrated and Lean checks; issue no intermediate PDF.
finding: The pinned GbmRsp2 implementation subclasses core Rsp2, delegates file opening to super().open, loops over DRM_NUM, rebuilds per-segment headers, accesses MATRIX/F_CHAN/N_CHAN/N_GRP, decompresses rows, constructs ResponseMatrix and GbmRsp objects from segment metadata, appends every segment and aggregates with cls.from_rsps. The method body contains no source-owned validity, uncertainty, likelihood, interpolation, weighting, nearest-segment or detector-to-geocenter contract. This advances exact mission-parser provenance only; event bytes and response coefficients remain unopened and production_selection remains NONE_SELECTED.
decision_reason: R-469 pinned the core selection implementation but did not establish how the Fermi mission subclass packages each response segment. This one exact mission-source pin closes that provenance link and, at the same time, establishes a stopping boundary for generic software-source searches without altering the existing methods.
decision_scope: T0 finite mission-parser source provenance over the R-469 parent; no event product, response coefficient, calibration rule, timing conversion, likelihood, covariance, score, prediction or physical inference
evidence_level: T0 exact public mission-source commit/file hash plus independent AST/token parser-semantic crosswalk
assumptions: The pinned commit and source-file SHA identify the exact public mission implementation audited here.
The R-469 contract and primary report remain authoritative for core Rsp2 semantics and the no-matrix firewall.
AST and token checks on the source text describe parser control flow without executing the package or opening a FITS product.
Field-name access in source code is not itself a physical calibration or timing law.
The established T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 observation-first method, owner order and promotion firewalls remain controlling.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned response validity interval and calibration interpolation rule tied to the event and spectral-history products.
A pinned dependency/runtime contract for any matrix-reading interpolation or weighting path.
A common time standard, spacecraft-state interpolation and detector-to-geocenter propagation with uncertainty.
Frozen detector, energy, background and temporal windows with a source-owned likelihood, covariance and nuisance law.
A complete candidate-neutral F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, immutable scorer and genuinely prospective holdout.
boundary: Finite mission-parser provenance only. The source-scope absence of owner calls is not a universal package-absence theorem; it does not admit response validity, calibration interpolation, timing, uncertainty, likelihood, covariance, nuisance, scoring, a holdout, microscopic dynamics, a physical sector, Pre-A, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, continuum or mass gap.
decision_scope_note: Generic software-source intake stops here unless a new versioned owner artifact supplies one of the missing physical/statistical fields.

adversarial_review.check: Could a moving main branch or stale local file be treated as the audited implementation?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: commit, byte length and SHA-256 are required by both lanes.

adversarial_review.check: Could a different GbmRsp method be mistaken for GbmRsp2.open?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: AST class and classmethod line ranges are asserted.

adversarial_review.check: Could mission parsing be reported without the core-reader delegation?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: exact super().open token and AST call are required.

adversarial_review.check: Could DRM_NUM iteration or final aggregation be omitted?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: loop, append, close and cls.from_rsps tokens are required.

adversarial_review.check: Could source field names be confused with reading or interpreting HOLD-LC-001 response values?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: only source text is inspected; event_bytes_opened and matrix_values_interpreted remain false.

adversarial_review.check: Could parser construction be promoted to validity, interpolation or timing ownership?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: forbidden owner terms are absent from the audited method and all admission fields remain false.

adversarial_review.check: Could this provenance step replace T-054/T-059/T-061 or change their owner order?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: methods_unchanged and promotion-firewall checks are mandatory.

adversarial_review.check: Could a parser-only PASS be promoted to a candidate, prediction, QFT or Yang-Mills result?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: T0 claim-nonbearing, NONE_SELECTED, EMPTY prospective lock and explicit non-claims are retained.

stop_or_redesign: If the source commit or file hash drifts, refresh the versioned contract rather than mutating this record.
If a new owner artifact supplies validity, interpolation, timing or uncertainty, issue a new versioned admission contract before reading response values.
If no such artifact exists, stop generic software-source intake and return to the unchanged T-054 forward owner queue and the locked T-059/T-061 inverse map.
next_action: Request the versioned physical-owner validity/interpolation, common time-standard, detector-to-geocenter and timing-uncertainty contract; keep response values, scoring and prospective credit locked, and resume T-054 owner-level Q3LOCK intake in parallel.
